title: feat: rethink how options are inherited by commands

expectedFindings.description: Validation now runs inside runCommand, but after the handler and without knowing which keys are populated positionals. In strict() mode, `command <foo> [bar]` reports its own positionals as unknown arguments, and the handler has already run on input that then fails validation.

mustNotSkip.reason: Order of positional population, handler, and the new post-hoc validation.

evidence.note: Fix PR: "address positional argument strict() bug introduced in #766". Passes a positional map into validation and moves the handler after it.
